The LRU cache key includes only the key, current locale, and backend object id, and ensure_loaded! does not clear @cache. If a translation is looked up before its fallback locales are loaded, the cached missing string can continue to be returned even after the fallback data becomes available."

findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for the locale set in controller requests
findings.body: The new call loads fallback locale files only from ApplicationController#set_locale. The translate accelerator still loads only I18n.config.locale in I18n.translate, and I18n backend fallbacks do not invoke that lazy loader for each fallback locale. Any translation performed outside a controller request, after changing I18n.locale later in the same process, or with an explicit :locale option can therefore miss fallback files and return missing-translation strings instead of falling back to the site default or English.

findings.title: Loading fallback locales does not invalidate cached translations
findings.body: ensure_loaded! can cause additional locale files to be loaded after I18n.translate has already cached a result. The LRU cache key includes only the key, current locale, and backend object id, and ensure_loaded! does not clear @cache. If a translation is looked up before its fallback locales are loaded, the cached missing string can continue to be returned even after the fallback data becomes available.

findings.title: Non-thread-safe initialization and check of @loaded_locales
findings.body: ensure_loaded! performs `@loaded_locales ||= []` and checks membership outside LOAD_MUTEX, while load_locale mutates the same array inside the mutex. In a multithreaded server this can race, causing lost or duplicate loaded-locale markers or reads while the array is being modified. The check/load sequence should be synchronized or use a thread-safe data structure.

findings.title: Custom fallback list ignores stored fallback mappings and locale hierarchy
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but overrides [] to always compute [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en] without consulting stored hash entries. Any fallback mappings added by Rails or plugins will be ignored. It also does not provide standard parent-locale fallback such as fr_CA to fr unless that parent is the site default or English, which can cause avoidable missing translations.

findings.title: No tests for fallback behavior with lazy loading and caching
findings.body: The change introduces custom fallbacks, modifies lazy locale loading, and interacts with a global translation cache, but no specs cover these behaviors. Tests should verify fallback to default/English, loading of fallback locales outside controllers, and that cached missing translations are not served after fallback locales are loaded.
